# Changelog

## 0.1.0 — 2026-10-26

- Initial public package: local boxes, arrows and multilingual labels for existing screenshots.
- Strict input validation, scaled coordinates and target/label collision checks.
- Exclusive output creation with rollback on ordinary write errors.
- Evidence hashes and location provenance; absolute local paths omitted by default.
- Portable Python setup, pinned dependency, optional Playwright adapter and synthetic examples.
- Core regression tests and optional adapter contract tests.
